'''International relations'''
*[[Myanmar]]'s [[Union Government of Myanmar|Union Government]] revokes [[Kyaw Moe Tun]]'s status as the country's [[Permanent representative to the United Nations|permanent representative]] to the [[United Nations]], accusing him of illegal activities, as the [[UN Credentials Committee]] prepares to consider the country's disputed representation. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Datu Usman Mampen Elementary School shooting]]
**Three people are killed and 15 others are injured when gunfire erupted outside a school in [[Cotabato City]], [[Bangsamoro]], [[Philippines]], used as a [[polling station]] for the [[2026 Bangsamoro Parliament election|Bangsamoro Parliament election]] the following day. [[Philippine National Police|Police]] say that members of rival [[political faction]]s clashed while competing to be first in line to vote. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2026/09/14/three-shot-dead-15-wounded-ahead-of-polls-in-philippine-muslim-enclave (AFP via ''The Star'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Law enforcement in Mexico|Law enforcement]] agents rescue eight people who they say were forcibly recruited by the [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] from a [[Clandestine chemistry|clandestine clinic]] in [[Tecalitlán]], [[Jalisco]], [[Mexico]]. Police arrest six suspected guards and seize drugs, weapons, and ammunition. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/12/mexican-authorities-rescue-eight-from-violent-cartels-secret-site (Al Jazeera)]
*An attack on the [[Panguna mine]] in the [[Provinces of Papua New Guinea|autonomous region]] of [[Autonomous Region of Bougainville|Bougainville]], in [[Papua New Guinea]], injures personnel and destroys equipment amid opposition to plans to reopen the [[copper mine]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260914-bougainville-leader-says-violence-won-t-stop-panguna-mine-re-opening (AFP via France 24)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/attack-hits-panguna-camp-bougainville-backs-copper-mine-restart-2026-09-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[Turkish police]] detain at least 63 people in raids targeting [[LGBTQ rights in Turkey|LGBTQ+ organizations]] and venues across several [[Provinces of Turkey|provinces]]. The [[Ministry of Justice (Turkey)|justice ministry]] says investigations involve 162 suspects, nine associations and 13 businesses over alleged offences including [[Prostitution in Turkey|prostitution]] and [[obscenity]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/14/turkish-authorities-launch-anti-lgbtq-raids-detaining-dozens (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025–2026 Kosovo political deadlock]]
**The [[Assembly of Kosovo|Assembly]] of [[Kosovo]] is declared constituted by [[Acting (law)|acting]] [[President of Kosovo|president]] and [[Speaker of the Assembly of Kosovo|speaker]] [[Albulena Haxhiu]], but without the deputy speaker from the [[Democratic Party of Kosovo|PDK]]. The Assembly then accepts the [[Fourth Cabinet of Albin Kurti|fourth cabinet]] of incumbent [[Prime Minister of Kosovo|prime minister]] [[Albin Kurti]]. The PDK and the [[Alliance for the Future of Kosovo|AAK]] both challenge the legitimacy of Kurti's government at the [[Constitutional Court of Kosovo|Constitutional Court]]. [https://apnews.com/article/kosovo-government-kurti-crisis-5c3727cfbcf04a3cc5734972fa6ea6c0 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/kosovo-parliament-re-elects-albin-kurti-prime-minister-2026-09-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Swedish general election]]
**[[Swedes]] vote to elect all 349 seats of the [[Riksdag]]. Incumbent [[Prime Minister of Sweden|prime minister]] [[Ulf Kristersson]], who seeks to lead the [[Moderate Party|Moderates]] to a second consecutive government while including the [[right-wing populist]] [[Sweden Democrats]] in his cabinet, is being challenged by the former prime minister and [[Swedish Social Democratic Party|SAP]] leader [[Magdalena Andersson]]. Preliminary results indicate that the [[Red-Greens (Sweden)|Red-Greens]] and the [[Centre Party (Sweden)|Centre Party]] are projected to have a combined total of 175 seats, while the four [[Tidö Agreement|Tidö parties]] are projected to have a total of 174 seats. [https://apnews.com/article/sweden-election-parliament-kristersson-andersson-6671108eecef137f7bb9a9f545983c23 (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/sweden-election-far-right-eyes-power-for-1st-time/a-79248599 (DW)]
*[[Disinformation in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] sanctions his former [[press secretary]], [[Iuliia Mendel]], and nine others for allegedly spreading [[Russian propaganda]] and supporting [[Russia]] in [[Russo-Ukrainian war|its war]] against [[Ukraine]]. The 10-year sanctions include [[asset freeze]]s and [[trade restriction]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/ukraines-zelenskiy-imposes-sanctions-former-press-secretary-2026-09-13/ (Reuters)]
